text:
Type: self-watering rectangular plant pot
Use: growing herbs or small plants on a windowsill or a shelf; kitchen, living room, home office
Style: minimalist, Scandinavian, modern
Materials: matte glazed ceramic, separate water reservoir tray with a filling spout
Colors: off-white, warm light grey
Shape: long low rectangular trough sitting on a matching base tray, rounded corners, small curved notch and spout at one end for refilling, compact and solid
Feel: clean, tidy, calm, practical
Goes with: herbs and green plants, light wood, white walls, sunny windows; minimalist or Scandinavian kitchens and living rooms

product.name: STCITRON
product.description: Will help your plant to thrive, even if you can't water regularly.
